revisions.value: Approximately 380 million cells from 98 datasets, used for pretraining and evaluation together.
revisions.passage: Here, we present ProtCell, a foundation model developed using approximately 380 million cells from 98 datasets for pretraining and evaluation.
revisions.reason: The abstract gives the figure for pretraining and evaluation together and no pretraining-only split, so the value is reworded to say what the figure covers.
